vested: Read historical schedules, returnable property, tribunal and implementation provisions together. Return cannot be confirmed without identifying the property and applicable orders.
vested-kha: The 2013 amendment provides for cancellation of the Kha schedule. An old Kha listing is not evidence of present vested status. Ordinary title, possession and remedies need separate verification.
vested-transfer: Read the transfer restrictions for returnable property. An app note, tax receipt or lease does not automatically authorise a sale.
vested-claim: Check claims, jurisdiction, filing requirements and applicable time limits against the original provisions and amendments. This platform does not file tribunal cases.
vested-appeal: The governing law determines the forum for vested-property appeals. A local district-administration review is not a substitute for that appeal.
sat: Read the basis for records of rights, tenancy, record maintenance and remedies. Mutation and final determination of title are separate matters.
reform: Consult the original law and current amendments for agricultural land, holding ceilings and applicable provisions. No ceiling is applied automatically without checking land category and exceptions.
tax-law: Read the original tax-assessment provisions. A sample payment is not a statutory assessment. Keep holding, demand and payment evidence separately.
tax-demand: Compare holding details with the tax demand and applicable provisions. Correcting a disputed demand and verifying a receipt are separate steps.
crime: Read land-offence and remedy provisions. Filing, investigation and legal decisions may belong to different authorities. The app does not declare anyone guilty.
acquisition-law: Read the original law on notices, objections, compensation and requisition. Check applicable 2026 rules against the ministry index as well.
transfer: Read the applicable sale, gift, mortgage and lease provisions. Records, deeds, possession and litigation require joint verification.
registration: Read the original deed-registration, presentation and copy provisions with their amendments. This workspace does not complete government e-registration.
eregistration: Consult the current text, including section 77A, for authorised software and e-registration provisions. This platform is not government-approved registration software.
stamp: Verify stamp-duty provisions and the current schedule. A sample app fee is not stamp duty.
tenancy: Read tenancy provisions applicable to non-agricultural land, subject to the land category and any special provisions.
relief: Read the conditions for declarations of title and other specific relief. An app reviewer cannot issue a court's declaratory decree.
limitation: Check suit and appeal time limits, special laws and applicable exceptions together. A general app calculator does not determine legal rights.
demands: Read certificate procedures and public-demand recovery provisions. Retain notices, objections and orders as evidence.
cht-reg: Read the hill region's special administrative provisions. Do not assume plains land procedures apply automatically.
cht-custom: Check circles, headmen and regional provisions in the original text, along with the jurisdiction of councils and customary authorities.
laws-index: Use the official index to find 2026 acquisition rules, land-use publications and new amendments. An indexed document is not proof that every provision has been interpreted or verified here.
appeal-rules-2025: These rules were published in the official gazette on 17 April 2025. Do not rely solely on an older webpage referring to 1990 rules. Check the original gazette, amendments and competent forum. The app neither files nor adjudicates board cases.
appeal-board-scope: This is the board's official subject-matter overview. Read older rule references alongside the 2025 gazette and later changes. Not every civil or vested-property case belongs before this board.
coverage:original: Selected reading guidance for official texts; the full law is not reproduced here.
coverage:guide: Previously checked official guidance; confirm the document's applicability and any newer version.
coverage:appeal-rules-2025: A reading guide to the official gazette; deadlines and jurisdiction are not determined automatically.
coverage:appeal-board-scope: A subject-matter overview; confirm the proper legal forum for a particular case.
coverage:fee-reference-2026: Checked against the scanned one-page ministry circular dated 17 February 2026, reference 107. Existing applications, payments and receipts were not repriced.
coverage:mutation-first-order: Indexed official stages; an app queue is not a statutory delegation.
coverage:survey-appeal-limitation: Survey-stage guidance; no automatic deadline or admissibility decision.
coverage:waterbody-2026-notice: An example from a particular district; not a nationwide set of terms or current deadline.
coverage:lease-procurement-boundary: A process boundary; no e-GP registration or government contract execution.
coverage:cht-jurisdiction-reference: Selected official text; not a title or jurisdiction opinion for a particular property.
coverage:draft-survey-records: Checked against the official portal's draft-record notice; not verification of a particular parcel's record.
